description: Stage two of promoting a proxy compiler to an intermediate CA. Pin this compiler into the PE ICA Compilers classifier group, a child of PE Intermediate CA, which sets pe_ca_ica_enabled and clears enable_ca_proxy on profile::master (profile::compiler_ica_ca's ica_enabled is inherited from the parent group). Also clears ca.conf's ica-pool, the one setting nothing else manages. Refuses to run unless enable_ica_provisioning has been applied and a Puppet run has written the ca.conf ICA settings, and submit_ica_csr has created the ICA passphrase. Does not write bootstrap.cfg, install a certificate, or restart any service: those happen on the compiler's next Puppet run. Called after operator approval of the pending CSR; not meant to be run directly.

primary_host.description: Certname/FQDN of the PE primary hosting the classifier this task pins the compiler into.
